steps.note: The three bunker NPCs after the ending, one story each: scorched (Vector and Malhotra speak, Phantom counts), joined (narrator beats for Vector and Malhotra), executed (Phantom writes something down).

said: Keep walking. I'll catch you up.
Out first. I'll count us after.
Relay's down. Get out with the others.
Malhotra takes his headset off and doesn't look at you.
Phantom writes something down and says nothing.
